anchor_value: USD-denominated fair value columns marked with $ in the source schedule

culprit_citations.quoted_text: AMF Levered II, LLC ... Cost $ 12,596 ... Fair Value $ 12,660

rationale: FX02 flagged fair_value_currency value U_USD as not USD. The raw investment schedule labels the cost and fair value columns with dollar signs and shows representative position and total rows in dollars. U_USD is therefore a USD unit representation, not a non-USD currency; the row-validation check is over-strict on unit normalization rather than a data error in the holding rows.
